complianceReadiness.title: Compliance Readiness Matrix
complianceReadiness.description: Readiness against SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and CIS. Readiness only.

staleIdentity.title: Stale identity: {principal} ({provider})
staleIdentity.recommendation: Review whether this access is still needed; remove or rotate if not.
staleIdentity.impact: Unused credentials widen the attack surface with no benefit.

neverUsedIdentity.title: Never-used identity: {principal} ({provider})
neverUsedIdentity.detail: Created {days} days ago with no recorded login or use.
neverUsedIdentity.recommendation: Confirm this principal is required; remove if it was never activated.
neverUsedIdentity.impact: Dormant accounts are a common foothold for attackers.

privilegedNoMfa.title: Privileged account without MFA: {principal} ({provider})
privilegedNoMfa.detail: Role "{role}" has admin-level access but MFA is disabled.
privilegedNoMfa.recommendation: Require and enable MFA on this account immediately.
privilegedNoMfa.impact: A single phished password grants full administrative control.

mfaStateUnavailable.title: MFA state unavailable for {count} privileged identity(ies)
mfaStateUnavailable.detail: These providers do not expose per-account MFA status via their API.
mfaStateUnavailable.recommendation: Confirm MFA is enforced and attach evidence for these accounts.

providerError.title: Provider "{provider}" is in an error state

stripeReadFail.title: Stripe configuration could not be read
stripeReadFail.detail: The Stripe API call failed during collection.
stripeReadFail.recommendation: Verify STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set and can read prices and webhooks.
stripeReadFail.impact: Billing posture is unknown until Stripe is reachable.

stripePriceMismatch.title: Stripe price/env mismatch
stripePriceMismatch.detail: {name} points to a price that is not active in Stripe.
stripePriceMismatch.recommendation: Point the env var at an active price, or activate the referenced price.
stripePriceMismatch.impact: Checkout can reference a price that no longer exists, breaking purchases.

stripeWebhookNone.title: No Stripe webhook endpoint configured
stripeWebhookNone.detail: No webhook endpoints were returned by Stripe.
stripeWebhookNone.recommendation: Add a webhook endpoint covering payment and subscription lifecycle events.
stripeWebhookNone.impact: Failed payments and cancellations may not propagate to the app.

stripeWebhookMissingEvent.title: Stripe webhook missing "{event}"
stripeWebhookMissingEvent.detail: No configured webhook endpoint subscribes to {event}.
stripeWebhookMissingEvent.recommendation: Add {event} to a webhook endpoint so the app reacts to this event.
stripeWebhookMissingEvent.impact: Important billing events are not delivered to the platform.

stripeWebhookUnverified.title: Stripe webhook event coverage not verified
stripeWebhookUnverified.detail: Webhook endpoints exist but their subscribed event list was not collected.
stripeWebhookUnverified.recommendation: Confirm each endpoint subscribes to required payment/subscription events.

supabaseHealthFail.title: Supabase health check failed
supabaseHealthFail.detail: The Supabase reachability check did not succeed.
supabaseHealthFail.recommendation: Verify the project URL and service-role key, and that the database is online.
supabaseHealthFail.impact: Core data layer availability is unconfirmed.

serviceRoleInClient.title: Service-role key reachable from client code
serviceRoleInClient.detail: The service-role key (which bypasses RLS) was detected on a client-exposed path.
serviceRoleInClient.recommendation: Move all service-role usage strictly server-side and rotate the key immediately.
serviceRoleInClient.impact: Full database access could be extracted by any visitor — severe data-breach risk.

rlsDisabled.title: Table "{table}" has RLS disabled
rlsDisabled.detail: Row Level Security is not enabled on {table}.
rlsDisabled.recommendation: Enable RLS on {table} and add explicit access policies.
rlsDisabled.impact: Without RLS, a leaked anon key can read or write this table directly.

rlsUnverified.title: RLS coverage not verified
rlsUnverified.detail: Table-level RLS state was not collected for this run.
rlsUnverified.recommendation: Enumerate tables and confirm RLS is enabled on every table holding user data.

publicBucket.title: Storage bucket "{bucket}" is public
publicBucket.recommendation: Confirm public access is intended; otherwise make the bucket private with signed URLs.
publicBucket.impact: Public buckets may expose user-uploaded or internal files.

vercelNotConnected.title: Vercel not connected
vercelNotConnected.detail: No Vercel token is configured, so deployment posture cannot be assessed.
vercelNotConnected.recommendation: Connect Vercel to include deployment and env-var checks in the audit.

publicSensitiveEnv.title: Public env var looks sensitive: {name}
publicSensitiveEnv.detail: {name} is exposed to the browser (NEXT_PUBLIC_) but its name suggests a secret.
publicSensitiveEnv.recommendation: Rename to a server-only variable (drop NEXT_PUBLIC_) and rotate the value.
publicSensitiveEnv.impact: Secret values shipped to the browser are readable by anyone.

envScopeDrift.title: Production and Preview env vars differ
envScopeDrift.detail: Only in production: {onlyProd}. Only in preview: {onlyPreview}.
envScopeDrift.recommendation: Reconcile env var names across scopes so preview reflects production.
envScopeDrift.impact: Preview deploys may behave differently from production, masking bugs.

githubReadFail.title: GitHub could not be read
githubReadFail.detail: The GitHub API call failed during collection.
githubReadFail.recommendation: Verify the GitHub token and its repo scope.

branchProtectionUnverified.title: Branch protection not verified
branchProtectionUnverified.detail: Branch protection state for the default branch was not collected.
branchProtectionUnverified.recommendation: Confirm the default branch requires pull-request review before merge.

branchProtectionMissing.title: Default branch "{branch}" does not require PR review
branchProtectionMissing.detail: Changes can be merged to the default branch without an approving review.
branchProtectionMissing.recommendation: Enable branch protection and require at least one approving review.
branchProtectionMissing.impact: Production code can change without a second set of eyes.

staleBranches.title: {count} stale branch(es) older than {days} days
staleBranches.recommendation: Review and delete merged or abandoned branches.
staleBranches.impact: Stale branches add confusion and may carry outdated config.

clientExposedSecret.title: Client-exposed secret: {name}
clientExposedSecret.detail: {name} appears to be a secret but is exposed to the client.
clientExposedSecret.impact: A leaked production secret can be abused by anyone.

rotationUnknown.title: Rotation age unknown for {count} secret(s)
rotationUnknown.detail: Provider APIs do not expose last-rotation dates for these credentials.
rotationUnknown.recommendation: Record rotation dates in the Key Vault and set a rotation policy.

backupTestMissing.title: Backup recovery test not on record
backupTestMissing.detail: No evidence of a tested database backup/restore was collected.
backupTestMissing.recommendation: Perform a restore test and attach the result.
